d:
Jharkhand men Cyclone ka bara update, 20 navanbar ko 5 jilon men bhari barish ka Orange Alert...
Jharkhand men chakravati tuphan ka asar dikhne laga hai. mausam vibhag ke anusar, bangal ki khari men bane chakravati tuphan ke karan 19, 20 aur 21 navanbar ko rajy ke kaee jilon men bhari se bahut bhari barish hone ki sanbhavna hai.
Mausam vibhag ne 20 navanbar ko purvi sinhbhum, pashchimi sinhbhum, saraykela-kharsavan, bokaro aur dhanbad men bahut bhari barish ko lekar orenj alart jari kiya hai. vahin ranchi, khunti, ramgarh, gumla, lohradga aur simdega men yelo alart hai.
